sect1.title: Introduction
sect1.para: The physics module provides high-performance functionalities for various physics-related calculations and constants, optimized with Cython and accelerated using CUDA kernels. This module ensures efficient and accurate computation of physical quantities, crucial for high-energy physics analyses within the AnalysisG framework.

sect1.title: Contents
sect1.para: This module contains optimized physics calculation functions and constants, many of which leverage CUDA for parallel execution on GPUs. Specific contents will be detailed as they are implemented, highlighting their GPU-accelerated nature where applicable.
